title: Catupiry brasileiro caseiro
creator: kitchenchapters

items.note: 48% fat, 200 ml plus about 75 ml to finish

steps: Heat the milk until it's just about to boil, add the vinegar, stir gently and let it curdle for 1–2 minutes.
Strain through a fine sieve, keeping only the curds.
Blend the warm curds with 200 ml cream and the salt on high for 2–3 minutes until smooth (don't over-blend).
Cook in a saucepan with the butter and mozzarella over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fully melted and uniform.
Blend again for at most 1 minute until silky. Stir in more cream little by little (up to 100 ml) until it has the consistency you like.
